1. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of __C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, and arylalkyl with at least one terminal carbon atom having a branched structure__.

2. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is __individually__ C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl.

3. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is __specifically__ methyl or ethyl, __wherein each is separately provided as an independent option__.

4. (Currently Amended) A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of __sodium,__ alkali metals and alkaline earth metals.

5. (Currently Amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (Il b) in which Z is __specifically__ sodium or potassium, __wherein sodium and potassium are distinguished based on their predictable chemical behavior in a solution environment__.
